studio2.todo: Bowling-style strike, giant marble ball vs ten pins (Gemini; built-in Studio II game) - installed
studio2.prompt: built-in Bowling (RCA Studio II shipped with Addition, Bowling, Doodle, Freeway, Patterns): a huge glossy amber-and-teal marble bowling ball smashing into ten white pins on a dark wooden lane, pins and splinters exploding outward, no people/characters, no signage (first try had neon signs with text; regenerated as a fresh composition with explicit right-side placement).

orao.name: Orao
orao.ctl: custom: Gemini flat top-down render of the Orao from a Wikimedia Commons photo (Orao-IMG 7278.jpg, CC licence)
orao.todo: Nevidljivi-style invisible presence in a foggy fortress courtyard (Gemini, original character) - installed
orao.prompt: Nevidljivi (The Invisible One, the one game on the Orao No 0 tape, Suzy Soft 1987; Orao also had Yugoslav ports/clones): original hooded investigator in a green coat (rear view) raising an oil lantern in a foggy Balkan fortress courtyard, an invisible presence shown only as a glassy shimmer, sparks and wet footprints. Scene guessed from the title; the game itself was not seen.
orao.credit: background generated with Google Gemini (original hooded investigator and an invisible presence, inspired by the Orao game Nevidljivi); system image is a Google Gemini top-down render based on a Wikimedia Commons photo of the Orao; logo is the TPN Carbon theme PEL Orao logo, sticker-styled.

ondra.credit: background generated with Google Gemini (original wanderer at an ancient crypt door, inspired by the puzzle game Tenebra); system image is a Google Gemini top-down render based on a Wikimedia Commons photo of the Ondra; logo is the TPN Carbon theme Ondra logo (dark panel removed), sticker-styled.
